abilities.name: pressure
abilities.effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

abilities.name: super-luck
abilities.effect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.

abilities.name: justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a dark move.

hoenn.flavorText: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived POKéMON that has a life-span of 100 years.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.

updated-johto.flavorText: It has the ability to foretell natural disasters. Its life span is over a hundred years.

original-unova.flavorText: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.

updated-unova.flavorText: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.

kalos.flavorText: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom bringer.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Absol has the ability to foretell the coming of natural disasters. It lives in a harsh, rugged mountain environment. This Pokémon very rarely ventures down from the mountains.

original-alola.flavorText: Although it’s said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

updated-alola.flavorText: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

swsh.flavorText: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.
